items.title: Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM) Is Planting Deeper Roots In East Africa With Nairobi Hub
items.summary: Archer-Daniels-Midland (NYSE:ADM) has opened a new marketing office in Nairobi to support its East African expansion plans. The Nairobi hub is intended to strengthen ADM's local supply chain presence and connect regional buyers with its global network. The new Kenyan office targets customers across the broader East African market, including food processors and industrial users of agricultural products.
